taskTypes.name: Generic task
taskTypes.description: Plan, execute, review, summarize. Works for most requests.

steps.goal: Understand the goal, gather the context needed, and write a short concrete plan.
Execute the plan. Produce the actual deliverable (code, document, or answer).
Review the deliverable against the end goal. Fix small issues directly; report anything unresolved.
Write the final user-facing summary of what was done and where the outputs are.

taskTypes.name: Quick answer
taskTypes.description: Demo: analyst works out the answer, writer turns it into a Discord-ready post.

steps.goal: Answer the question accurately and concisely with key facts and caveats.
Turn the analyst's answer into a short Discord-ready post.

taskTypes.name: Explain and review
taskTypes.description: Demo: explainer drafts, critic checks accuracy, writer publishes.

steps.goal: Explain the topic simply in under 120 words.
Check the explanation for errors or misleading simplifications and fix them.
Publish the corrected explanation as a short Discord post.

taskTypes.name: Code fix (test-first)
taskTypes.description: Demo: tester reproduces, coder fixes, tester verifies.

steps.goal: Reproduce the reported problem and write a failing test case that captures it.
Fix the problem with the smallest correct change so the failing test passes.
Re-run the tests and report PASS/FAIL with evidence.

taskTypes.name: Coding (branch → test → PR)
taskTypes.description: Build a feature or fix in this repo (dashboard app included): code on an isolated worktree branch, test, review, then open a GitHub PR. Never touches main.

steps.goal: Create a git worktree under data/worktrees on a new agent/* branch from origin/main, implement the end goal there, rebuild the dashboard if dashboard-app changed, and commit. Hand off the worktree path, branch, and changed files.

In the handed-off worktree, add/update tests for the change, run npm test (and npm run dashboard:build if the dashboard changed), fix small breakages, commit, and report PASS/FAIL with output. Fail if anything is red.
Review `git diff origin/main...HEAD` in the handed-off worktree against the end goal. Fail on any high-severity hole (security, data loss, broken UI); otherwise list remaining nits for the PR body.
Push the handed-off agent/* branch and open a pull request against main via the GitHub MCP tool, including test evidence and reviewer notes. Return the PR URL as a link artifact.
